used_results: two-dimensional product-marginal cap 2 for orthonormal projections

new_claims.statement: For the explicit exact-rank-three near-coloop family Q=4 delta (X0+H)^2+8(X0+H)U+4V^2, where (H,U) is an arbitrary dependent two-dimensional projection of one original product bank and V is a normalized projection of a disjoint original-coordinate bank, the completed sign-free dependent-pair/fresh-square theorem gives ||p_Q||_infinity<=4 uniformly in dimension and in all cap-one input laws.

In the same family, every single physical shared/fresh triple has |A_kk det A_{0jk}|=256/m^3, so the same fresh-square theorem applied after conditioning to one physical triple yields only 2^(5/4)m^(3/4), while aggregating the whole fresh rank-one source bank yields the uniform value 4.

The family has hub leverage >63/64, three nonzero eigenvalues of modulus >1, and for arbitrary tau_*>0 parameters can be chosen so that every physical diagonal and every physical 2x2 principal determinant has modulus <tau_* while ||p_Q||_infinity<=4.

projection_product_interface: For W=H/(eta sqrt(1+rho^2)), the pair (W,U) is an orthonormal two-dimensional projection of one original product bank and has joint density cap <=2. This is not an independence statement. The curved bound keeps (H,U) dependent and uses independence only between the disjoint source objects X0, (H,U), and V.
mechanism_obstruction: Do not demand one physical-coordinate fresh square with a uniformly bounded reciprocal determinant certificate. A whole disjoint original-coordinate rank-one bank may need to be normalized and aggregated before curvature is paid.
product_provenance_rule: Retain same-bank projected dependence explicitly; aggregate only disjoint original-coordinate source banks when claiming independence. Never infer projected-coordinate independence or replace a joint projection cap by a conditional cap.

next_implication.statement: In the general exact-rank-three near-coloop chamber, either extract a disjoint original-coordinate rank-one bank whose aggregate scalar supplies quantitative fresh-square curvature, or prove a genuinely shared-bank source-first transducer. Higher-rank extension remains separate.
